sisi.depan: An endless, glossy white floor recedes towards a faint horizon line where it merges completely with dense white fog.
sisi.kanan: A large, slow-drifting cluster of dark grey noise flecks floats in the mid-ground before dissipating into the surrounding void.
sisi.belakang: Behind the viewpoint, the glossy floor's reflection of the white void fades into an impenetrable wall of dense, shimmering static.
sisi.kiri: Thin, wispy trails of fine grey particles drift horizontally across the empty space.

tengah: The vast space between the camera and the horizon is completely empty, filled only with softly drifting motes of static.
atas: An infinite expanse of soft, even white light is populated by countless tiny, floating grey static particles that hang suspended in the air.
